snippet.title: UnLoop – More Time To Spy | Update 1.1.0 Trailer | Meta | PCVR | Pico
snippet.description:
Major Update 1.1.0 for UnLoop, titled “More Time To Spy” is available now for Meta Quest, Steam and Pico!

It introduces 25+ new levels, alongside two new mechanics: the Portable Shield and the Heavy Turret, as well as advances the game's storyline.

--------------------------------
UnLoop is a is a retro-futuristic VR puzzle game built around self-cooperative time loop mechanics. Each loop you start the level gain, working with yourself from past attempts – this is the only way forward.
--------------------------------

Steam – https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672470/UnLoop/
